name: ems
description: Education Management System (single institute). Runs on XAMPP (MariaDB) locally and Hostinger Node.js hosting (MySQL/MariaDB).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ems/admin && npm run build -w @ems/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,app -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @ems/api" "npm run dev -w @ems/admin"
